content: @fastify/rate-limit v11 supports a custom keyGenerator(request) function returning the bucket key; combine request.ip with a route param (e.g. resolved linkId) to get per-(IP,link) buckets for the password-verify endpoint, distinct from the project's existing per-IP-only overrides (MAGIC_LINK_RATE_LIMIT etc). Per-route override still goes through route-level config.rateLimit, same mechanism already used project-wide.
